_doc: Jun profiles (#18) and "what goes where": every piece of your Jun, and which of the three containers carries it. A container value is: always (can't be turned off), on (in by default, he can take it out), off (out by default, he can put it in), never (it can't go there; `why` says where it lives instead). The player's own picks are kept in localStorage jun.carry; none = the way we made it. Read by js/core/profile.js, checked by .github/scripts/js/profile.test.mjs.

profile.name: Jun profile
profile.line: A .jun file with how your Jun looks and acts. Share it, keep a few to switch between (Work, Evening), or drop one in from a friend. Never her memories.

gamesave.name: Game save
gamesave.line: Where you are in the game. Loading one brings these with it.

savepoint.name: Save point
savepoint.line: All of her, to go back to. Made before every update, restore and profile.

parts.name: Colors
parts.line: Every color you picked for her desktop pieces.

parts.name: Touch feedback and feelings
parts.line: Ripples, labels, thought icons, how her feelings show, the glow, her body.

parts.name: Touch spots
parts.line: Where each touch spot sits on her, and which are switched off.

parts.name: On the desktop
parts.line: Her size and how she acts out there: walks, dozes, talks, hiding, her house cube.

parts.name: Her spots
parts.line: The cushion, beanbag and the rest, their colors and where they are.

parts.name: Which features are on
parts.line: Every feature's switch, and how new features arrive after an update.

parts.name: Her own ways
parts.line: How often and how boldly she starts things, her quiet hours, how she waves, her courage and talk on delves, how quickly she tires of a touch.

parts.name: Voice and sound
parts.line: Her voice, its speed and language, the volume, how the mic listens.

parts.name: Her outfit
parts.line: What she's wearing and its colors (the clothes come from each player's own game copy).

parts.name: Your scenes
parts.line: The scenes you made in the scene maker. Applying a profile ADDS its scenes to yours: it never replaces or removes one. They can hold 18+ content; your own 18+ setting decides what shows.

why.gamesave: They're things you made, not where you are in the story: in a game save, loading an older save would lose a scene you wrote after it. What you've reached in a scene (firsts, the album) IS in your game saves.

parts.name: Names
parts.line: Her name and what she calls you.

parts.name: Comfort and ratings
parts.line: What you are to each other and what's switched on. 18+ is never turned on by a file: that stays your own choice, in Settings.

parts.name: Your bond
parts.line: How close you are. Not the natural way (earning it is), so it's out unless you put it in. She feels a change softly, like a half-remembered dream.

parts.name: The game's story
parts.line: Where you are in the story, your choices, the delve you're on, the play time.

why.profile: That's what game saves are for (Settings > The game).

parts.name: Your skills
parts.line: Your skill levels in the game. Off: loading a save keeps the skills you have now.

why.profile: Your skills come with your game saves.

parts.name: Your things
parts.line: Credits, the other currencies, items and keepsakes. Off: loading a save keeps what you own now.

why.profile: Your things come with your game saves.

parts.name: Her skills
parts.line: What she's learned and got good at.

why.profile: She earns them herself; only a save point brings them back.
why.gamesave: She keeps them whatever save you load: they're desktop Jun's.

parts.name: Memories and chats
parts.line: Everything she remembers and every conversation.

why.profile: Private to you, never in a file you might share. Save points keep them.
why.gamesave: Desktop Jun's memories are never rewound by a game save.
